seo.meta_description: KFC is owned by Yum! Brands, the same parent as Taco Bell and Pizza Hut. Here's the full ownership story behind Kentucky Fried Chicken.

question: Who Owns KFC?
quick_answer: KFC is owned by Yum! Brands, a publicly traded company that is also the parent of Taco Bell and Pizza Hut. KFC, short for Kentucky Fried Chicken, was founded by Colonel Harland Sanders, who began franchising in the 1950s. It became part of the company now known as Yum! Brands, which was spun off from PepsiCo in 1997.

body.heading: Who owns KFC?
body.text: KFC is part of Yum! Brands, one of the largest restaurant companies in the world. Yum! Brands is publicly traded and also owns Taco Bell and Pizza Hut, so KFC shares a parent with those two chains.

body.heading: Colonel Sanders and the roots
body.text: KFC traces back to Colonel Harland Sanders, who developed his fried chicken recipe and began franchising it in the 1950s from Kentucky. The 'Kentucky Fried Chicken' name and the Colonel's image are still central to the brand. Over the years the company changed hands and eventually landed under PepsiCo's restaurant division.

body.heading: How it became part of Yum!
body.text: PepsiCo spun off its restaurant business, including KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut, in 1997. That spin-off became Tricon Global Restaurants, later renamed Yum! Brands, which still owns KFC today.

faqs.q: Is KFC owned by the same company as Taco Bell?
faqs.a: Yes. KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut are all owned by Yum! Brands.
